source.name: Press Release For Business
source.terms: Headline, an excerpt of up to approximately 40 words, and a link to the canonical URL may be republished with attribution to the issuing organization. Full text may not be republished. All content on this wire is PAID content published on behalf of the named organization; it is their own statement and has not been independently verified. Publishers republishing this material should carry the same disclosure. See https://pressreleaseforbusiness.com/for-newsrooms/

feed.name: Optimized and Network releases
feed.description: Announcements editorially restructured with full entity markup.

releases.headline: Painter Hotline Announces 25% Off Interior and Exterior Painting Across the Denver Metro Through October 31
releases.snippet: Painter Hotline has announced 25% off interior and exterior painting projects across the Denver metropolitan area, running through October 31, 2026. The discount applies to project labor and does not include the cost of paint.

releases.headline: Rustic Barnwood Furniture Confirms Delivery of Custom Reclaimed Pieces Across the Denver Metro Area
releases.snippet: Rustic Barnwood Furniture has confirmed that its custom reclaimed barnwood pieces — dining tables, desks, benches and case goods — are built to order in Colorado and delivered across the Denver metropolitan area and Front Range.

releases.headline: Advertising For Contractors Warns Trades Businesses to Prepare Now as Google Folds Local Services Ads Into Google Ads
releases.snippet: Advertising For Contractors is advising trades businesses to prepare for Google's migration of Local Services Ads into Google Ads via pay-per-lead Performance Max campaigns, which began for US advertisers in August 2026 and removes the standalone LSA dashboard and manual…

releases.headline: Aging Safely Baths Publishes a Direct Answer on Medicare and Walk-In Tubs: Original Medicare Does Not Cover Them
releases.snippet: Aging Safely Baths has published guidance stating that Original Medicare does not cover walk-in tubs, which are classified as home modifications rather than durable medical equipment, and outlining the alternative funding routes that may apply.

releases.headline: Aging Safely Baths Highlights Bathroom Accessibility Planning as Households Reconsider Aging-in-Place Renovations
releases.snippet: Aging Safely Baths, a nationwide walk-in tub and barrier-free shower supplier operating since 2012, has published planning guidance for households considering bathroom accessibility renovations ahead of need rather than in response to an injury.

releases.headline: Elevation Health Pairs Registered-Dietitian Support With Physician-Prescribed GLP-1 Care as Research Highlights an Industry-Wide Support Gap
releases.snippet: Elevation Health structures its telehealth GLP-1 program around registered-dietitian support alongside physician prescribing, in response to published 2026 research identifying high discontinuation rates and limited nutritional oversight across the telehealth weight-management sector.

releases.headline: Eye To Ad Media Expands Generative Engine Optimization Practice as AI Assistants Reshape How Customers Find Local Businesses
releases.snippet: Eye To Ad Media has expanded its generative engine optimization practice, formalizing a service line focused on entity consistency, structured data and machine-readable publishing for businesses that need to appear in AI-generated answers.

releases.headline: Roof Solutions Urges Metro Atlanta Homeowners to Photograph Roofs Before Storm Season as Georgia Insurance Rules Shift in 2026
releases.snippet: Roof Solutions is advising Metro Atlanta homeowners to establish photographic documentation of roof condition ahead of storm season, citing 2026 changes to Georgia insurance legislation, a City of Atlanta cool roof ordinance and increased carrier scrutiny of roofs over 15…

releases.headline: World VR Mall Opens Browser-Based Virtual Shopping Concourse With Merchant Storefronts Linking to Live Ecommerce Sites
releases.snippet: World VR Mall has launched a browser-based three-dimensional shopping concourse where visitors walk a central walkway and enter merchant storefronts that link through to those merchants' own ecommerce sites. No headset or download is required.

releases.headline: Aging Safely Baths Launches Rebuilt Website With Faster Load Times and Clearer Accessibility Product Information
releases.snippet: Aging Safely Baths has launched a rebuilt website at agingsafelybaths.com, reorganized around configuration questions households face when planning walk-in tub and barrier-free shower installations.

releases.headline: Bighorn Painting Flags Closing Exterior Painting Window as Colorado Overnight Temperatures Approach the Coating Threshold
releases.snippet: Bighorn Painting is advising Front Range homeowners that the Colorado exterior painting season is closing, as most exterior coatings fail to bond below 50°F and overnight lows approach that threshold. The Arvada contractor has outlined what can still be completed…

releases.headline: Showers4Less Outlines Specification Differences Between Barrier-Free Shower Kits as Demand for Accessible Bathing Grows
releases.snippet: Showers4Less has published specification comparison guidance for barrier-free shower kits, covering pan construction, threshold height, wall system compatibility and the subfloor requirements that determine feasibility of a zero-entry installation.

releases.headline: VR Flying Simulator Launches Browser-Based Procedural Trainer Aimed at Student Pilots Between Lessons
releases.snippet: VR Flying Simulator has launched a browser-based procedural trainer for student pilots covering checklist discipline, instrument scan and navigation tracking. The company states explicitly that it is not an approved training device and logs no hours toward any certificate.

releases.headline: Search Converts Details Membership Structure for Small Business Growth Program Built Around Strategy Sessions and Community Distribution
releases.snippet: Search Converts has detailed the structure of its business growth accelerator, a membership program combining strategy sessions, campaign testing and distribution through community networks, positioned as an alternative to conventional advertising retainers.

releases.headline: Advertising For Contractors Releases a Free Chatbot Builder for Trades Websites
releases.snippet: Advertising For Contractors has released a free contractor chatbot generator that produces an installable website assistant, aimed at capturing inquiries that arrive outside business hours.

releases.headline: Aging Safely Baths Publishes Guidance on Grab Bar Reinforcement in Accessible Bathrooms
releases.snippet: Aging Safely Baths has published guidance on wall reinforcement for grab bars, addressing why the anchoring decision has to be made during installation rather than afterward.

releases.headline: Showers4Less Adds ANZZI Shower Products to Its Accessible Bathing Catalog
releases.snippet: Showers4Less has added ANZZI shower products to its catalog as an authorized dealer, widening the pan, enclosure and fixture options available alongside its existing barrier-free range.

releases.headline: Eye To Ad Media Introduces AI Search Visibility Assessments for Small Businesses
releases.snippet: Eye To Ad Media has introduced AI search visibility assessments that test how a business is represented when customers ask AI assistants about its category, and identify which competitors are named instead.

releases.headline: Painting Brighton Shifts to Interior Work as Colorado Exterior Season Closes
releases.snippet: Painting Brighton has shifted its scheduling to interior projects as Front Range overnight temperatures approach the threshold below which exterior coatings will not bond properly.

releases.headline: Eye To Ad Media Flags Holiday Hours as the Most Common Fourth Quarter Local Search Failure
releases.snippet: Eye To Ad Media has published fourth quarter local search guidance identifying incorrect holiday hours across business listings as the most common and most avoidable failure heading into the holiday season.

releases.headline: Aging Safely Baths Adds ANZZI Walk-In Tubs to Its Accessible Bathing Range
releases.snippet: Aging Safely Baths has added ANZZI walk-in tubs to its accessible bathing range, widening the configurations available to households working within an existing bathroom footprint.

releases.headline: Search Converts Adds Listing Consistency Audits to Its Small Business Services
releases.snippet: Search Converts has added listing consistency audits to its small business services, identifying where a company's name, address, hours and service description disagree across public listings.

releases.headline: Eye To Ad Media Publishes Review Response Guidance for Owner-Operated Businesses
releases.snippet: Eye To Ad Media has published review response guidance for owner-operated businesses, focusing on how to respond to negative reviews and which common responses compound the damage.

releases.headline: Painting Brighton Publishes Guidance on When Cabinet Refinishing Works and When It Does Not
releases.snippet: Painting Brighton has published guidance on cabinet refinishing, setting out the conditions under which refinishing is appropriate and the cases where replacement is the better decision.
